# Elara Interiors

> Elara Interiors is a contemporary interior design company that designs and builds complete home interiors for apartments, villas and independent homes in India.

## Services
- Consultation, interior design, production, execution (installation) and after-sales service, handled by one team.
- Modular kitchens, bedroom interiors, living and dining spaces, wardrobes and bespoke furniture.

## Packages
- Complete 2 BHK home interior: ₹5,00,000. Living room (TV unit, 5-seater sofa), dining (6-seater set), modular kitchen (base and wall cabinets, 3 tandem drawers, cutlery tray, bottle pull-out, GTPT unit), common wash area (storage unit, mirror), master and guest bedrooms (king-size cot, side table, 3-door wardrobe, dressing table with mirror).
- Complete 4 BHK home interior: ₹7,50,000. Everything in the 2 BHK package plus a kids' bedroom and an additional bedroom, each with bed, side table, 3-door wardrobe and dressing table with mirror.
